text: Leon's mum is having her hip replaced sometime next week. He's driving up the day before and staying until she's home. Text him that morning.
Rin got the call on Friday: her whole team is being made redundant at the end of the month. She sounded flat but says she's been half expecting it.
Alfie had his gallbladder out on Tuesday. Home now and bored stiff. His girlfriend Ebony is doing all the cooking, which he says is a mixed blessing.
Need to send a card to Agnieszka. Her grandad died over the weekend and the funeral is in Kraków early next month.

Juan's brother Andre has split up with his fiancée after six years. The wedding they'd booked for June is off. Juan is putting him up for a while. Their mum is apparently taking it harder than Andre is, because she'd already bought the outfit and told the whole family. Andre has asked everyone not to mention it at Christmas, and he's thinking about going travelling over the summer to clear his head.
Siddharth has a consultant appointment about his knee sometime in the next fortnight. He's nervous they'll say he needs surgery.
Kiri mentioned her dad has been in hospital since Sunday with pneumonia. They're hoping he'll be discharged by the end of the week. I should check in with her on Thursday.
Bought the wrong size bin bags again. Return them and pick up the prescription on the way back.
Jakub and Alina are flying to Lisbon over half term, their first proper break since the baby. They both looked exhausted.
Felix's cat Pickle had a tumour removed last week. She's wearing the cone and hating it. Felix says the vet bill was eye-watering.
Duc is starting chemo in early November. His wife Simone is taking unpaid leave to be with him. Don't forget to ask Simone if they need meals dropping round.
Abigail Wright, Abi to everyone, finally has a date for her cataract operation: the 14th. She can't drive for a week afterwards, so I'm taking her to the follow-up appointment.

Asha's nan passed away in her sleep on Monday night. Asha is fine for now, she says, but it hasn't really sunk in. The funeral will probably be sometime next week. Her mum is organising everything and Asha is helping with the order of service. Her nan grew dahlias for decades and they want those on the coffin. I'd like to go if I can get the afternoon off.
Eva's mum has a biopsy on Wednesday and gets the results about ten days later. Eva is trying not to think about it.
Helen loves the Archers and has listened to every episode since 1998. Her husband Connor hates it.
Remind me to ring Connor after his scan on Thursday afternoon. He said he'd know more by the evening.

Miriam's son Tendai has broken his wrist falling off a trampoline. Cast on for six weeks, which wipes out his football season. Miriam is more upset than he is, since she's already paid for the summer camp. He's mostly annoyed that he can't play on his Xbox one-handed.

Mehmet Yilmaz lost his job at the warehouse last month. He's been applying everywhere and has an interview at the council sometime next week. He's really anxious about it. His wife is still working part time, but the mortgage renewal is coming up early next year and he's worried they'll struggle. He asked if I'd look over his CV, which I said I'd do this weekend. Need to send him a good luck text the morning of the interview.

Aneesh's partner left in the summer and he's only just started talking about it. He said the worst part is the dog went with her. He's been throwing himself into work and running, and has signed up for the Brighton half marathon in April. His sister Rin thinks he's avoiding dealing with it, but he seems to be doing better than in September.
Lukas has his ACL reconstruction at the end of the month. Recovery is six to nine months. He's gutted about missing the ski trip in February.
The memorial for Eduardo's father is on Saturday at eleven, with a reception at the cricket club afterwards. I'm going with Catalina.
Catalina mentioned her sister is having a C-section in early March. Twins! Catalina is flying out to Bogotá a week after to help.
Must post the sympathy card to Omar and his family today. His uncle's funeral was yesterday.
Aiko's surgery went well. She was sitting up and eating toast the next day, which the nurses said was a good sign. Send her the audiobook she asked about.

Dimitri says his mother is moving into a care home sometime over the next few weeks. He feels guilty about it, even though she chose it herself. He and his brother are clearing out her bungalow over the next couple of weekends, and he said finding his dad's old letters nearly finished him off. I should offer to help with the van.

Joanna was let go on Monday with no warning. Fourteen years at the bank. Her kids don't know yet, and her husband Mehmet is away on a work trip until the end of next week, so she's dealing with it alone. She has a meeting with HR on Thursday about the package and wants someone to read the paperwork with her afterwards. I need to take her for lunch sometime next week.
Leon's dad is a retired surgeon and still corrects everyone's medical terminology at dinner.
Rin's brother Felix is getting his stitches out on Friday. She's driving him there and taking him for pancakes afterwards.
Alfie and Ebony had to cancel their anniversary trip because his mum fell and broke her pelvis. They'd been planning it since spring.
Juan asked me to look after their rabbit, Biscuit, while they're at the funeral in Seville at the end of next week.
Agnieszka's husband Jakub has a hernia operation on the 3rd. She's worried because he's terrible at resting. Text her the day after to see how he's getting on.
Siddharth mentioned that his wife Kiri is coeliac and his son is vegetarian. Worth remembering if we have them round.
Duc's daughter starts nursery the week after his last chemo session. He's hoping he'll feel well enough to do the drop-off.
Quiet day. Did the big shop, cleaned the oven and finally booked the dentist for sometime in early December.
Asha said her dad's funeral is on Tuesday and the wake is at the Red Lion afterwards. Her brother Omar is giving the eulogy and is terrified. I should message Omar the night before.
Eva and her girlfriend have broken up. They'd been together since uni. Eva is staying with her parents until the end of the month while she looks for a flat.
Helen's knee surgery has been postponed again, now probably early spring. She's fed up and in a lot of pain.

Connor's mum died on Sunday. He was very matter-of-fact on the phone but kept apologising for rambling. The funeral is likely to be late next week. Don't forget to send flowers to his house the day before, and ask Helen whether there's a collection at work.
Miriam is having her wisdom teeth out on the 22nd. Bring her soup the day after.
Mehmet's daughter Alina has just been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. She's eight. The whole family is learning to count carbs.
Aneesh said his grandmother's ninetieth is sometime in the spring, and she has hinted she'd love a digital photo frame.
Lukas told me his boss is being made redundant and the team will be restructured over the summer. He's not sure where that leaves him.
Must call Eduardo tomorrow. His wife Catalina had her scan this morning and they were waiting on results.
Simone works nights as an ICU nurse at St Thomas'. She said the ward has been chaos since the winter wave started.
Tendai's mum mentioned he has a hospital appointment about his asthma sometime next week. He's eleven and very blasé about it.
Aiko and her husband are selling the house after his redundancy. They'll probably move closer to her parents in Leeds by the end of the year.
Omar is recovering from a slipped disc. He's off work until at least mid-November and is going stir crazy. His physio is twice a week.
Andre's grandfather's funeral was yesterday. I couldn't make it. I should text him to see how it went and how his mum is holding up.
Ask Dimitri how his dad's angiogram went. It was on Monday morning and they were expecting the results that afternoon.
Joanna's brother Felix is in rehab after the car accident. He'll be there at least until Christmas. She visits every Sunday and comes home drained.
Leon and his wife have separated. He's moved into a flat above the bakery on Mill Road. Very calm about it, which worries me more than if he were upset.
Rin's grandmother has dementia and no longer recognises her. Rin finds the visits really hard but goes every week anyway.
Phoned the surgery about my blood test results. They said someone will call back sometime this week.
Kiri's son Jakub has his tonsils out on Thursday. She's taking the day off and the day after. Order him some ice cream and a Lego set before then.
Alina said her dad, Dr Kumar, is retiring at the end of the year after thirty years as a GP. There's a party for him in early January.
Felix and Joanna's dog Rolo had to be put to sleep this morning. They're heartbroken. He was fifteen.
Agnieszka is nervous about her MRI next Tuesday. She's claustrophobic and has asked for sedation. Message her that morning to wish her luck, then check in the day after.

Spent an hour on the phone with Ebony. Her mum's stroke was three weeks ago and she's now in rehab. Ebony has been sleeping on the ward most nights and hasn't been back to work. Her partner Juan is holding the fort with the kids. She said the hardest part is the not knowing; the doctors keep saying it's early days. She's hoping her mum will be home sometime over the summer, but realistically it might be longer. I should drop round on Saturday with food and take the kids to the park for a few hours.
Catalina's ex-husband is moving back to the area at the end of the month, which she is not thrilled about. Their two kids are excited though.

Siddharth had his appendix out last Thursday in the middle of a family holiday in Crete. His sister Asha flew out the day after to help with the kids. He's back home now and says the hospital food was surprisingly good. I need to ask him how the follow-up goes sometime next week.
